zero_locus_bounds.scope: The monotonicity and Fourier sign arguments are read and explained in review.md; these exact inequalities support them.

abstract_Hodge_counterexample.argument: The two lines spanned by(1,tau) and(1,conjugate(tau)) are Qbar-defined. An endomorphism of Z+Z*tau beyond Z would force a quadratic equation overQ for tau, impossible. This refutes the overbroad abstract Betti-Hodge assertion in the model-generated UQ answer, not Katz’s algebraic-elliptic-curve conjecture.
